sourceOfTruth.purpose: Screen contracts connect route state, controller ownership, section composition, captures, and design references.
sourceOfTruth.components: Reusable primitive and compound contracts remain in design/components/catch.components.json.
sourceOfTruth.runtime: Flutter source owns app behavior; this registry owns the target screen composition map and drift checks.
sourceOfTruth.workflow: Add a screen here before migrating it into state-owned section composition.
sourceOfTruth.layout: This file holds the registry's shared fields. Each screen and contract is its own file under design/screens/registry/ (screens/<id>.json, layout_contracts/, layout_only_routes/, imperative_pages/), named by its key; tool/design/lib/screen_registries.mjs merges them and the checks validate the merged registry against catch.screens.schema.json.
